subject: Mechanical Engineering
title: Tribology: The Science of Surfaces in Contact
description: Learn Tribology: The Science of Surfaces in Contact in one minute.

hook.text: Friction, wear, and lubrication form one science called tribology.

buildup.text: The word comes from Greek tribos — to rub. It was coined in 1966.

discovery.text: Tribologists study how surfaces interact at every scale, atoms to bridges.

twist.text: Poor tribology costs nations up to 6% of GDP in wasted energy and wear.

climax.text: Better coatings and lubricants save billions in fuel and parts each year.

punchline.text: Managing how surfaces rub saves the world billions.

quiz.question: What does tribology study?
options: Only the chemistry of lubricants and greases
Friction, wear, and lubrication — surfaces under relative motion
The strength and hardness of metals used in bearings
